Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-01T16:20:00Z
Subject: Recap & MAP draft: PeakData - Redwood pilot scope and next steps

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery: PeakData wants a 6-week pilot that validates low-latency embeddings and document search for your internal research team. Key constraints you called out: data residency for EU-origin data, SSO for pilot users, and a short procurement runway.

I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan ("PeakData_MAP_v0.2.xlsx") with proposed milestones. High level:
- Milestone 1 (Week 0–1): Access + onboarding (owner: PeakData IT)
- Milestone 2 (Week 1–2): Security & SOC2 evidence review (owner: Redwood SRE)
- Milestone 3 (Week 2–4): Data ingestion + embedding validation (owner: PeakData Data Eng)
- Milestone 4 (Week 4–6): Pilot evaluation + decision (owner: PeakData Product)

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm procurement's expected signature date so we align the MAP and proposed pilot start? You mentioned aiming for mid-May.
2) Please confirm any additional dependencies (legal redlines or PO requirements) so we can include owners and target dates.

If it helps, Ben can propose updated milestone owners and a tightened signature runway. Next step: I'll follow up with an updated MAP after we get procurement dates.

Attachments: PeakData_MAP_v0.2.xlsx

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Helpful. A few notes after checking with procurement and legal:
- Procurement needs a signed contract in hand by 2028-05-18 to hit our internal June 1 pilot start (we have an internal kickoff on 6/1).
- Legal will likely raise a couple of minor redlines around data retention and breach notification windows — I'll loop in Daniel Cho (legal) separately.
- Procurement will also require a vendor onboarding questionnaire + SOC2 evidence; I'm attaching our PO/requirements list so you can validate any gaps.

Attachment: PeakData_POC_requirements.pdf

If you can shift the MAP so signature is targeted for 2028-05-17 (one day buffer), that should work. Please include an explicit owner for the security evidence item—procurement will not move until they see that owner on the plan.

I'll ask procurement to introduce John Smith (procurement lead) on the thread shortly.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Product
PeakData
